paragraphs: R' Yehoshua ben Petar Rosh. See the entry: R' Yehoshua ben Mamal.[^1]

notes.text: פתר ראש is unvocalized; Petar Rosh is a conventional transliteration without interpreting or identifying it. The title at the end of the first source line belongs to the complete target Yehoshua ben Mamal. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
